subject: Request: reissue redacted invoice + reverse-charge VAT handling (Acme Tools)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Luca Moretti <luca.moretti@acmetools.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: reissue redacted invoice + reverse-charge VAT handling (Acme Tools)

Hi Luca —

Quick follow on invoice INV-8843 (issued 2026-09-28). Finance flagged that the invoice includes 19% VAT and lists Acme Tools' German VAT ID as the billing party. Per our contract and the place-of-supply for software services between an EU-registered buyer and our US entity, we expect reverse-charge treatment (net invoice, buyer accounts for VAT).

Two asks so we can clear payment hold:
- Can you reissue the invoice net of VAT and remove any collection of German VAT (line-level credit or reissued net invoice is fine)?
- Please attach a copy of Acme Tools' VAT registration evidence (EU VAT certificate or gov portal screenshot) so we can keep the file for audit.

I've attached a redacted draft that removes PII and shows the expected layout (draft-redacted-invoice-8843.pdf). For your convenience we've also attached the URL where we will accept the corrected invoice (DocuSign link if you prefer).

If there are local withholding/GST customs on your side we can also route payment differently — cc'ing Vanessa and Rishi from billing to help coordinate. Ideally we can have the corrected invoice by EOD Thursday 2026-10-08 to avoid late collection steps.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Payments Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: draft-redacted-invoice-8843.pdf (pdf, redacted sample)

From: Luca Moretti <luca.moretti@acmetools.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@acmetools.com
Date: 2026-10-05T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: reissue redacted invoice + reverse-charge VAT handling (Acme Tools)

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear note. Apologies — this invoice was generated automatically by our ERP with default VAT settings. We can reissue net of VAT, but our tax team needs to confirm our German VAT ID proof for your records.

We will:
1) Provide a PDF of our EU VAT certificate (or government validation printout).
2) Reissue the invoice as net (credit note + new invoice) and send both documents.

I expect both docs by tomorrow morning CET. One question: do you need the credit note to reference the original invoice number, or is a standalone corrected invoice acceptable? Our system prefers credit notes + reissue.

Regards,
Luca Moretti
Head of Finance, Acme Tools

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Luca Moretti <luca.moretti@acmetools.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-06T08:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: reissue redacted invoice + reverse-charge VAT handling (Acme Tools)

Luca —

Credit note + reissue is preferred (please reference INV-8843 on the credit note). That mapping keeps our AP reconciliation neat. A couple of compliance asks to make this audit-ready:
- The credit note should explicitly state: "Reverse charge applies under Article 44/196 of EU VAT Directive — customer liable for VAT."
- Reissued invoice should show net lines, zero VAT charged, and include Acme Tools' validated VAT ID (DE123456789) in the customer VAT field.
- Please embed or attach the EU VAT certificate (gov validation screenshot acceptable).

I've attached the VAT certificate we received from your side earlier today for completeness (acme_vat_certificate_DE123456789.pdf). If you can confirm the credit note references the original invoice and include the text above, we will release payment immediately upon receiving the corrected invoice.

Also copied our collections playbook link in case your tax team needs a format example: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Thank you — looking forward to the reissued docs.

Best,
Kim

Attachments: acme_vat_certificate_DE123456789.pdf (pdf)

Subject: Re: Request: reissue redacted invoice + reverse-charge VAT handling (Acme Tools)

Team — quick internal note after Luca's reply:

1) Once we receive the credit note + reissued invoice, run standard VAT-ID validation in our payments system (we have a saved validation flow for DE IDs). If gov portal returns valid, mark invoice as reverse-charge eligible and send to payouts.
2) If the external reissue incorrectly still charges VAT, we will accept a corrected credit note + reissue within 7 business days; otherwise escalate to collections and hold future shipments (per contract).
3) Rishi — please prepare the payment release checklist and a short comment for the Account record confirming receipt of the gov validation printout and credit note reference (ACME-INV-8843).

I will follow up if tax team flags anything unusual.

-Vanessa
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
